items.title: SET Trading Competition
items.text: SET is a 56-day crypto trading competition. You trade your own money on your own exchange accounts, and you are ranked on how well you traded, not on how much you made. It is free to enter. There is no entry fee, no deposit to SET, and nothing you give us can move your funds.

items.title: When it runs
items.text:
Event Date / Time Registration opens Now Trading starts 23 November 2026, 12:00 UTC Trading ends 18 January 2027, 12:00 UTC Registration closes 17 January 2027, 12:00 UTC

That is exactly 56 days, noon to noon. You can join late. Registration stays open until 24 hours before the end, and joining late is not a disadvantage in itself. You are scored on the days you traded, not penalised for the ones you missed. Twenty strong days beats fifty-six indifferent ones. Only trading inside the window counts. Anything you do before 23 November or after 18 January is invisible to your score.

items.title: What you need
items.text:
Venue What it is What you give SET Coinbase Spot Buying and selling the asset itself A View-only CDP key: key name and private key Coinbase Perpetuals Perpetual futures, a separate portfolio from spot The same, scoped to your perps portfolio Lighter Perpetuals only, there is no spot market A read-only token beginning ro:

You can enter on one venue or all three. Each is registered and scored separately, and your Sharpe is computed across everything you register as one portfolio.

items.title: Minimum deposit
items.text: There is no entry fee and no deposit to SET. You fund your own exchange account and the money never leaves your control. To be ranked you need 100 USDC in the account. Below that you still appear, still get scored, and still count, just in the Not yet qualified tab rather than the ranking. Put 100 USDC in and you move up. It is measured against the highest your account has ever been worth, so once you have qualified, a bad day cannot send you back down. You also need 500 USDC of traded volume to be ranked. Both sides of a round trip count, so opening a 250 USDC position and closing it covers it. It is there because a Sharpe ratio can be flattered by trading almost nothing, and the whole point is to see you trade.

items.title: About the referral links
items.text:
Opening your account through SET's link is how the competition is funded. It costs you nothing.

  • Coinbase: if you already have an account, just add SET as your referrer. You do not need a new one.
  • Ligher: Lighter fixes the referral code when the account is created and it cannot be added afterwards, so this one does have to be a new account.

items.title: Keys
items.text:
Nothing you give SET can move your funds.

Venue Details Coinbase Your key's permissions are checked against Coinbase when you register. If it can trade or transfer, it is refused. If the check itself fails, that is also a refusal, never a pass Lighter A ro: token is incapable of signing. There is nothing to check, because there is nothing it could do
  • What SET can see: your balances, and your closed orders, on the accounts you registered.
  • What SET cannot do: place an order, cancel one, move funds between your accounts, or withdraw anything. There is no code in our system that can trade.
  • How your keys are stored: verified against the exchange first, then encrypted before they are written down. They are never shown back to you or to anyone else.
  • What happens to the data: The privacy notice at set.trade/privacy is the full account: what we collect, who receives it, how long we hold it and how to have it deleted. The short version is that your trading records go to the partner firms, your email address and your keys do not, and everything we hold is deleted within 30 days of the end. Email contact@set.trade to have yours removed sooner.

When you are finished, revoke your keys. Do it at the exchange. That is all it takes: our access ends immediately, you do not need our permission or our help, and it works the same way if you want to leave mid-competition.

Warning

Never send anyone a Lighter wallet private key. Not us, not anyone. A wallet key cannot be revoked. The form refuses anything that does not start with ro: for exactly this reason.

items.title: Rules
items.text:
• Read-only keys only. Anything that can trade or withdraw is rejected when we check it against the exchange.
  • Open your accounts through SET's link, or add SET as referrer where the exchange allows it.
  • Use the account you already have. You do not need a brand new one, and nothing you traded before the competition is held against you. See "What counts" below.

Info

The one exception is Lighter, which fixes the referral code when an account is created and will not let you add one later. A Lighter entry needs a new account. Coinbase lets you add a referrer to an account you already have, so keep yours.

items.title: What counts
items.text:
Only what you do between 23 November and 18 January. Everything else is invisible to your score.

  • A trade filled before the start is not in your volume or your trade count.
  • A position you were already holding does not show up as profit. Your balance at the start is your starting line, and it already includes whatever that position is worth. Closing it during the competition moves your score by zero.
  • Nothing after the end date counts.
  • 100 USDC in the account to be ranked. See above.
  • 500 USDC of traded volume to be ranked. Both sides of a round trip count. See above.
  • Trade your own account. One entry per person.
  • Your display name and avatar are public. Your email and your keys never are.

items.title: Rankings
items.text:
The trading records go to our market-maker partners, who read them and decide for themselves who is interesting. A high placing is not an offer, a guarantee of one, or a promise that anyone will be in touch. And you do not have to win to be worth reading. Partners are looking for how somebody trades, not just who came first, so a strong 20-day showing from a late entrant can be more interesting to them than a mediocre 56-day one. Place twelfth with a clean, disciplined record and you may well get the call.

  • 56-Day Live Market Sprint: Test and deploy your automated trading algorithms in real market conditions across an 8-week competition window.

  • $100 Minimum Starting Capital: Participate with an accessible $100 balance spread across Coinbase and Lighter.

  • Ranking Matrix: Performance is evaluated using PnL%, volume, and Sharpe Ratio.

  • Earn an Industry Internship: Top-ranked participants earn an internship with our industry partners.

items.title: FAQs
items.text: Does it cost anything? No. No entry fee, no deposit to SET. You need 100 USDC in your own exchange account to be ranked, and it stays yours. Can I join after it starts? Yes, until 17 January. You are scored on the days you traded. What can I use in the competition? Bots, scripts, your own models, whatever you like. You are assessed on how the account trades, not on what placed the order. Partners hire people who automate well. I already have a Coinbase account. Do I need a new one? No. Add SET as your referrer and keep the account you have. What about Lighter? Lighter fixes the referral code when the account is created, so that one has to be a new account. I have been trading this account for years. Is that a problem? No. Prior trading is allowed and none of it counts. Scoring starts at 23 November, so your old trades are not in your volume, and a position you already hold is already priced into your starting balance. Closing it during the competition moves your score by zero. Do I have to close my open positions before it starts? No. Carry them if you want. They are valued at the start like everything else, so you are scored on what happens to them from then on, not on the gain you already had. I registered one venue. Can I add another later? Yes, register again with the same email address. It attaches to the same entry. Why has my Sharpe not appeared? Either you have fewer than three days of returns, or your equity has not moved. Hover the dash on your row and it will say which. Why am I in "Not yet qualified"? Usually it is the 100 USDC balance minimum or the 500 USDC volume minimum; fix whichever it names and you move up at the next update, within the hour. It can also be that you registered with a Coinbase account that was flagged as not having SET as its referrer. If that is the case, check your inbox, because we will have emailed you about it. I deposited more money. Does that help my score? No. Deposits and withdrawals are removed from every figure. Only trading moves your score. Can I change my display name or avatar? Not yet. There is no login, so choose carefully at registration I lost my API key / it expired. Make a new one and register again with the same email address. How do I leave? Revoke the key at your exchange. Email us if you also want your entry removed. My Lighter token expires, does that matter? Yes. Set the expiry past 18 January 2027. If it lapses your balance stops updating and your score goes stale rather than wrong. Is there a prize? The trading records go to market-maker partners who are looking for people to work with. There is no cash prize, and placing well is not an offer of anything. See above. Who sees my data, and for how long? The partner market-maker firms see your trading records, with your display name attached. Your email address and your keys never leave SET. We stop reading your accounts a week after the end and delete what we hold within 30 days. The privacy notice at set.trade/privacy has the detail, and contact@set.trade is where you ask for deletion.

items.title: Getting Started
items.text: Provided below are templates on how to connect to Coinbase and Lighter via CCXT or Hummingbot. Note: The following templates are reference examples; participants should independently verify all details.

items.title: Using CCXT
items.text:
To trade via CCXT Coinbase

import os
import ccxt

# Coinbase issues separate API keys for spot and for perpetuals.
spot = ccxt.coinbase({
    "apiKey": os.environ["COINBASE_SPOT_API_KEY"],
    "secret": os.environ["COINBASE_SPOT_API_SECRET"],
})


# Perpetuals run on Coinbase's derivatives gateway, which ccxt reaches through
# coinbaseinternational. The override works around a bug in ccxt 4.5.90 that
# breaks the gateway login in Python. Remove it once ccxt fixes it.
class CoinbasePerps(ccxt.coinbaseinternational):
    @staticmethod
    def extend(*args):
        return ccxt.Exchange.extend(*({} if a is None else a for a in args))


perps = CoinbasePerps({
    "apiKey": os.environ["COINBASE_PERP_API_KEY"],
    "secret": os.environ["COINBASE_PERP_API_SECRET"],
})

print(spot.fetch_balance()["total"])
print(perps.fetch_balance()["USDC"])   # read USDC only - see below
print(perps.fetch_positions())

# Placing orders (real money):
# spot.create_order("BTC/USDC", "limit", "buy", 0.0001, 50000)
# perps.create_order("ETH/USDC:USDC", "limit", "buy", 0.01, 2000)

Lighter
import os
import ccxt

lighter = ccxt.lighter({
    "privateKey": os.environ["LIGHTER_WALLET_PRIVATE_KEY"],
    "options": {
        "accountIndex": int(os.environ["LIGHTER_ACCOUNT_INDEX"]),
        "apiKeyIndex": 5,                                  # any free index, 4-254
        "libraryPath": os.environ["LIGHTER_SIGNER_PATH"],  # Lighter's signing library
        "builderFee": False,                               # turn off ccxt's own fee
    },
})

print(lighter.fetch_balance()["USDC"])
print(lighter.fetch_positions())

# Placing an order (real money):
# lighter.create_order("ETH/USDC:USDC", "limit", "buy", 0.01, 2000)

items.title: Using Hummingbot
items.text:
To trade via Hummingbot, view the installation guide, or developer guide 

import asyncio
import os

from hummingbot_api_client import HummingbotAPIClient

ACCOUNT = "master_account"


async def main():
    # Initialize client
    client = HummingbotAPIClient(
        base_url="http://localhost:8000",
        username="admin",
        password="admin"
    )
    await client.init()
    try:
        # Step 1: Add exchange account
        print("🔑 Adding Exchange Account...")
        try:
            account = await client.accounts.add_account(account_name=ACCOUNT)
            print(f"✓ Account '{account['account_name']}' added successfully!")
        except Exception as e:
            if "Account already exists" in str(e):
                print("ℹ️ Account already exists, continuing...")
            else:
                raise

        # Step 2: Add credentials for Coinbase (spot)
        print("\n🔑 Adding Coinbase Credentials...")
        cred_result = await client.accounts.add_credential(
            account_name=ACCOUNT,
            connector_name="coinbase_advanced_trade",
            credentials={
                "coinbase_advanced_trade_api_key": os.environ["COINBASE_API_KEY"],        # organizations/.../apiKeys/...
                "coinbase_advanced_trade_api_secret": os.environ["COINBASE_API_SECRET"],  # -----BEGIN EC PRIVATE KEY-----...
                "use_auth_for_public_endpoints": False,
            },
        )
        print(f"✓ Credentials added: {cred_result}")

        # Step 3: Add credentials for Lighter (perpetuals)
        print("\n🔑 Adding Lighter Credentials...")
        cred_result = await client.accounts.add_credential(
            account_name=ACCOUNT,
            connector_name="lighter_perpetual",
            credentials={
                "lighter_perpetual_l1_address": os.environ["LIGHTER_L1_ADDRESS"],                  # 0x... wallet that owns the account
                "lighter_perpetual_api_key_index": int(os.environ["LIGHTER_API_KEY_INDEX"]),
                "lighter_perpetual_api_private_key": os.environ["LIGHTER_API_PRIVATE_KEY"],
                "lighter_perpetual_account_limit": "Standard",   # your account type: Standard, Plus, Premium or Builder
            },
        )
        print(f"✓ Credentials added: {cred_result}")

        # Wait for account sync
        await asyncio.sleep(2)

        # Step 4: View portfolio
        print("\n📊 Fetching Portfolio...")
        portfolio = await client.portfolio.get_state()
        print("Portfolio State:")
        for account, exchanges in portfolio.items():
            for exchange, balances in exchanges.items():
                for balance in balances:
                    print(f"  {account}/{exchange}: {balance['units']:.2f} {balance['token']} (${balance['value']:.2f})")

        # Step 5: Get trading rules
        print("\n📏 Getting Trading Rules...")
        for connector, pair in (("coinbase_advanced_trade", "BTC-USDC"),
                                ("lighter_perpetual", "ETH-USD")):
            rules = await client.connectors.get_trading_rules(
                connector_name=connector,
                trading_pairs=[pair]
            )
            print(f"  {connector} {pair}:")
            print(f"    Min Order Size: {rules[pair]['min_order_size']}")
            print(f"    Min Price Increment: {rules[pair]['min_price_increment']}")

        # Step 6: Place limit orders - real money, priced well below the market
        print("\n💱 Placing Limit Orders...")
        spot_order = await client.trading.place_order(
            account_name=ACCOUNT,
            connector_name="coinbase_advanced_trade",
            trading_pair="BTC-USDC",
            trade_type="BUY",
            amount=0.0001,
            order_type="LIMIT",
            price=20000
        )
        perp_order = await client.trading.place_order(
            account_name=ACCOUNT,
            connector_name="lighter_perpetual",
            trading_pair="ETH-USD",
            trade_type="BUY",
            amount=0.02,
            order_type="LIMIT",
            price=1000,
            position_action="OPEN"
        )
        for order in (spot_order, perp_order):
            print(f"✓ Order {order['order_id']} submitted")
            print(f"  Status: {order['status']}")
            print(f"  Type: {order['order_type']} {order['trade_type']}")
            print(f"  Amount: {order['amount']} @ ${order['price']}")

    except Exception as e:
        print(f"❌ Error: {e}")
    finally:
        await client.close()

# Run the complete example
if __name__ == "__main__":
    asyncio.run(main())

items.title: How you are scored
items.text:
You are ranked on your Sharpe ratio, not your profit.

Info

  • Account size does not matter. Returns are percentages, so $200 and $200,000 are measured on the same scale.
  • Deposits and withdrawals do not count as performance. They are stripped out of every figure. Adding money mid-competition does not help you and taking it out does not hurt you. Only trading moves your score.
  • Consistency beats one big win. A single enormous day raises your average and your volatility, and often lowers your Sharpe.
  • Not trading is not a strategy. Sitting flat gives you no measurable volatility and therefore no Sharpe at all, so you drop below everyone who has one. There is also a minimum balance and a minimum volume, so parking money in the account and leaving it alone does not work either.

items.title: When your score appears
items.text: A Sharpe needs three days of returns, which is four daily balances, so the first Sharpe figures appear around 26 November. Before then nobody has one and the board orders on return instead. Each person crosses that line on their own history, not on a shared date: a late entrant waits three days from their own first day. You are ranked from your first scored day. There is no waiting period and no probation. The Days column shows how much history your score rests on, so anyone reading the board can see the difference between a four-day score and a forty-day one. The board updates about once an hour.

items.title: The Leaderboard
items.text: Column What it means Sharpe The default ordering, best first. Hover a dash to see why it is empty PnL % Your return from trading, with deposits and withdrawals removed Volume Notional of every order filled during the competition. Both sides count: opening a 100 USDC position and closing it is 200 Equity Your account value inside the competition window. It freezes when the competition ends Days How many days of returns your score rests on Trades Closed orders during the competition Spot / Perp Your current balance on each. A dash means you did not register that venue

items.title: Leaderboard tabs
items.text:
• Leaderboard: everyone who has qualified, ranked.
  • Not yet qualified: everyone who has not, listed with the reason. You are still synced, still scored, and still in the data. Nobody is ever removed from the board; somebody who vanished could not tell that from never having registered.
